The FPU routine ORs MSR with 0x900 and saves, masks and reloads the current context's FPU state using FPSCR &= 0xFFFFF. The replacement avoids both a complete-reset implication and an unsupported full-range installation claim.

The setup guard, attempted registration range and SDK conflict are verified. Both callback bodies clear retrace hooks before reporting, and the OS callback first extracts DSISR then DAR. The document and proposal consistently preserve the installation deferral.
